title: sphaenolobium tianschanicum
intro: Sphaenolobium tianschanicum, commonly known as the Tianschan salswort, is a type of plant that belongs to the Boraginaceae family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Sphaenolobium tianschanicum include its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, which are known to have a range of biological activities, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
